body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Haier introduced its digital camera 'DC-A20' at CES 2010.
DC-A20 features waterproof with a protective casing up to 10 feet, 9.0 Megapixel, 6×Optical Zoom lens.

With options and features that reduce red-eye and aid in image stabilization, Haier's digital cameras make it easy for consumers to take great photos. One simple connection allows for quick uploads of video and photos to computers, printers or online. All Haier cameras support YouTube video upload to share videos with friends and family. All units are available Q1 2010.
